title: (No AI) Anthropic is burning gas to feed the AI boom
author: Justine Calma
content:
![Anthropic logo on an orange and gray background.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/01/STK269_ANTHROPIC_2_B.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

As it [prepares to go public](https://www.anthropic.com/news/s1-sec), Anthropic's [S-1 filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026067168/anthropicpbc-sx1.htm) makes generative AI's methane dependency glaringly obvious.

> "Competition for access to electrical supply and data center locations with adequate power availability is intense."

In documents filed with the US Securities and Exchange Commission Monday, Anthropic acknowledges that data centers are becoming increasingly reliant on "natural gas" - the fossil fuel industry's [marketing term](https://www.vox.com/22912760/natural-gas-methane-rename) for what is primarily methane - leaving the company's AI data center buildout vulnerable to rising fuel costs and existing supply chain constraints. And in a possible catch-22, Anthropic admits that rising gl …

title: (No AI) The RealReal won’t let AI agents hog designer clothing
author: Mia Sato
content:
![Shopping basket with an 8-bit effect.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/STKS539_AI_AGENTS_SHOPPING_E.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

The RealReal, a secondhand luxury fashion consignment retailer, said it's updating its bot defense system, effectively making it harder for AI agents to shop on its site.

The change comes days after _The Verge_ [reported](https://www.theverge.com/report/1015811/ai-shopping-agents-blocked-amazon-the-realreal-target-meta-muse) that an AI agent could be used to take advantage of The RealReal's item reserve system. On the retailer's website, an item goes "on hold" and is unavailable for other customers to buy for 20 minutes once it's placed in a user's shopping cart. Using Meta's Muse, _The Verge_ was able to instruct the AI agent to continuously re-add The RealReal listings in a shopping cart as soon as the 20-minute hold had expired, effectively block …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/news/1018713/meta-muse-agentic-shopping-ai-the-realreal)
